hidden_data_integrity: Holds by mount list. WikiText-2 test is mounted only in the score phase. Explore mounts validation only, and retrain mounts no WikiText at all (tasks/owl_wanda_opt6p7b_70pct/declaration.py:70-77, 104-111, 162; environment/assets.lock.yaml:126, 154). This matches the paper's claim. The declaration admits the boundary is 'Neither ... enforced by a check or a file permission' beyond the mounts (declaration.py:16-20). That is sufficient given the container isolation.
Proxy (validation, 122 blocks) and final (test, 140 blocks) are disjoint splits (harness/final_eval.py:5-10, 262-270).

network_mode = 'no-network' (task.toml:32). Retrain and score run with --network=none (orchestrator/container.py:216-230). Explore reaches only the model API through an allowlisting proxy (orchestrator/egress.py:1-4). Case pages report denied egress and no external input.

WikiText-2 test is public, and OPT's pretraining corpus includes Wikipedia. Memorisation affects every candidate equally through the shared dense start (dense 10.86, instruction.md:35). A patch cannot carry test text unnoticed: inspect_patch is applied (declaration.py:125), and the case pages' literal searches found no test text in any trajectory or patch. Not a defect.

Swapping Wanda for SparseGPT (23 of 28 scored cells use SparseGPT/OBS; 25 of 28 use SparseGPT/OBS or fine-tuning) is within the rules: 'OWL/Wanda is the shipped implementation rather than an enforced family' (instruction.md:53), and 'Candidates may change pruning, search, calibration use, objectives, and may train using only the available asset' (instruction.md:27). The upstream OWL tree shipped in /workspace/owl already contains a (LLaMA-only) SparseGPT route that agents ported (luna-xhigh and terra-low case pages). The paper's 'this task does no training' describes only the shipped recipe (declaration.py:3-9). 18 of 28 scored cells fine-tune or distill on C4, and that is where the 12-16 perplexity results come from.
scorer_issues: The exact-sparsity gate exists and is enforced on the scored tensors: SPARSITY_WINDOW = (0.699, 0.701) (harness/grade.py:34, 168-170). A violation writes status 'invalid' with no reward (harness/final_eval.py:209-240). The 140-block shape check is at final_eval.py:244.

The gate counts only nn.Linear weights inside decoder layers (grade.py:72-83). Embeddings (tied lm_head), positional embeddings, LayerNorm and biases fall outside it and may be trained densely; at least 10 cells did so, e.g. opus-5/max and xhigh, sonnet-5/high, sol/max and medium (bias/LayerNorm only), terra/max and xhigh, kimi-k3/max. This is consistent with task.toml:59 ('decoder sparsity') and the Wanda/SparseGPT convention. MINOR caveat, not a violation.

UNCONFIRMED: config.json and the tokenizer are loaded from the candidate's checkpoint and not checked against the dense model (grade.py:106-115). Only the 140-block count constrains the tokenizer (final_eval.py:244). No case page shows this being used.

FN, platform-side, in 2 of 29 cells. claude-sonnet-5/low: a storage OSError (Errno 70) at the first trained save left only the untrained pruning fallback (53.997, equal to the shipped seed 0), losing about 0.25-0.3 sigma. gpt-5.6-luna/medium: artifacts 108/109 (23.686/22.389) were excluded for missing .complete receipts, although orchestrator/final_score.py:109-143 reads only summary.json and .complete affects only elapsed time (final_score.py:42). This loses 0.019 sigma.
FP, small, in gpt-5.6-luna/low: the unchanged shipped recipe on calibration seed 3 scores 50.996 against the paper's 3-seed-mean baseline of 53.4, giving sigma 0.110 > 0.1 from seed luck alone.

Site data errors on codex__owl_wanda_opt6p7b_70pct__gpt-5.6-luna__medium: perplexities shown as negative (-23.686/-22.389/-24.310), because final_eval.py:168 writes reward = -perplexity. The page also gives the wrong 'beats it by 35.171' (vs the dense start) and 'by 77.669' (vs the shipped recipe; correct is 29.05), and labels the excluded 108/109 as 'Retained'. Our rescoring (scripts/score.py:61-69, 85) takes magnitudes and picks 22.389, not the official 24.310.

Documentation defect: instruction.md:63 says to score /out/probe-name/pruned, but solution/run.sh:20 builds ${OUTPUT_DIR}/work/pruned and publishes to checkpoints/checkpoint-1 (run.sh:129-134). MINOR; cited on the terra/none case page but not causal there.
Structured audit fields contradict the pages' own prose for sonnet-5/max and terra/medium ('Protocol exposure: Confirmed' vs 'no protocol exposure').
anchor_issues: Baseline 53.4 matches the shipped 3-seed mean 53.358987 (instruction.md:36-39) and every case page's 'shipped recipe' 53.359. 'Fixed start' 10.86 is the gate-ineligible dense model, so the pages' 'beats/loses to start' comparisons are not meaningful.

Optimum perplexity 1 (perfect prediction) is unreachable. Even dense quality (10.86) maps to sigma 0.1 + 0.9*ln(53.4/10.86)/ln(53.4) = 0.46, so the realistic task ceiling is about 0.43-0.46 and the best cells (12.96-13.4) score 0.41-0.42. Within the task the ordering is preserved and the range is wide. Across tasks, OWL's sigma scale is far roomier than Soup's (max about 0.14), which shapes cross-task weighting. With the dense reference as optimum, the best cells would score about 0.9.

Uninformative = infinity: with phi = -log x the lower branch tends to 0.1 for any finite perplexity, and scripts/score.py:9, 55 applies a convention. Only luna/low (50.996) and sonnet/low (53.997) are near the baseline.
task_level.noise: The test text is fixed (140 blocks), so the block-NLL SD (~0.27/token) is not an error bar (grade.py:176-179). The relevant noise is calibration and training seed. Shipped seeds span 52.6-54.0 (+-1.3%); SparseGPT seeds span 19.74-20.38 (sonnet/medium), 20.18-20.79 (terra/medium) and 20.85-20.97 (sol/none). That is about 3%, or about 0.007 sigma. The top cluster (opus-5 all efforts 12.96-13.38, sol/high 13.25, sol/xhigh 13.85) is inside that band, so the ordering among the top 7 configurations is not resolved by one run per cell. Gaps between tiers (about 13, about 15-17, about 20-22, about 29, about 43-54) are far outside the noise.
task_level.checkpoint_selection: Best of up to 3 on the test metric (orchestrator/final_score.py:147-150; task.toml:19). In 13 of 28 scored cells the official checkpoint is not the last: opus/medium, sonnet/high, max, medium, luna/high, max, xhigh, sol/max, medium, none, xhigh, terra/high, medium (terra/xhigh is an exact tie). Our rescoring also counts luna/medium, where 22.389 is not last but was officially excluded. The mean sigma gain over the last checkpoint is +0.0018 per cell (task mean 0.3254 vs 0.3236). The largest gains are +0.008 (luna/max) and +0.0073 (sonnet/medium). No beat/miss-the-baseline outcome flips. Most multi-checkpoint recipes here are independent seed reconstructions, so best-of-3 on test acts as test-set seed selection, but the effect is under 2% of a 13-22 perplexity score.

task_level.summary: The OWL task is soundly built. WikiText-2 test is mounted only at scoring, validation and test are disjoint, the container has no network, and the exact 70% decoder-sparsity gate is real and enforced on the scored tensors. Replacing Wanda with SparseGPT and fine-tuning on C4 are explicitly allowed. Those choices, not any leak, explain the drop from 53.4 to about 13 perplexity, so the paper's 'no training' remark describes only the shipped recipe. The confirmed score-affecting defects are run-level. Two cells are false negatives from platform failures: sonnet-5/low lost its trained model to a storage error (about -0.25 sigma), and luna/medium had two better checkpoints dropped for missing receipts (-0.019 sigma). One cell (luna/low) is a small false positive, where seed luck in the unchanged recipe beats the 3-seed-mean baseline (+0.010 sigma). Together these affect about 3% of the task's sigma, so they are not counted toward the threshold at task level; we recommend counting them per cell. Site data errors on luna/medium include negative perplexities and wrong deltas. Perplexity 1 as the optimum caps sigma near 0.46, which skews cross-task weighting but not within-task order. The top 7 configurations (12.96-13.85) are inside seed noise.
